_comment: Everything on the site that changes without the pages changing. tools/build.py reads this; edit here, run the build, commit.
_testflight_join_url: The external group's Public Link, https://testflight.apple.com/join/XXXXXXXX. Empty until the group's first build has passed Beta App Review; beta.html says 'coming soon' while it is empty. The flyer's QR code points at SITE_URL/beta, not here, so a printed flyer never goes stale.
_app_store_url: Filled in when 1.0 is on the App Store; the Get-the-app page switches from TestFlight to the store.
